name: Re:port Flow
description:
ReportFlow lets you create professional PDF documents directly from Claude,
using templates managed in ReportFlow.

Invoices, contracts, statements, quotations, certificates — if it's a
structured business document, you can generate it here.

To get started, connect the connector and just say:

    "Create an invoice with ReportFlow."

Claude will find a template, ask for the details it needs, and hand you a
finished PDF. From there you can:

- Generate a single PDF on the spot, or produce documents in batch
  (monthly statements, per-customer invoices, bulk contracts)
- Reuse the same template every time, so layout, branding, and structure
  stay consistent
- Download every generated file through a URL

How it works: ReportFlow is a remote MCP server using Streamable HTTP.
Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Flow with PKCE. When you
add the connector, you sign in to ReportFlow, select a workspace, and
grant permissions. Your templates and documents stay restricted to your
authenticated user and workspace.

ReportFlow doesn't replace template management — it gives you a
conversational interface for securely selecting templates, supplying data,
and generating documents from Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Re:port Flow to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Re:port Flow to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.re-port-flow.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Re:port Flow MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Re:port Flow provides these MCP tools: copy_gallery_template, fetch, generate_pdf_sync, generate_pdfs_async, get_design_parameters, get_gallery_template, list_templates, search, search_gallery_templates, and suggest_params.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Re:port Flow?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Re:port Flow in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Re:port Flow MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Re:port Flow requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Re:port Flow is developed by Mone-pla.inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
